purpose: Manual recovery checkpoint for current major-region planning progress.

intentionally_unassigned.reason: Leave room for future growth in the forever world; do not force every natural group into a region now.

decisions: Stone Highlands removed as a distinct region.
Frost Marches and Shattered Ice Coast are internal to The Great North.
Blackfen is internal flavor within The Haunted Marches.
Dappled Wilderness is internal flavor within The Timberlands.
Crystal Deep is underground beneath The High Kingdom.
Volcano is a landmark within The Isles of Plenty.
Pirate Island is an enclave within The Isles of Plenty.
The Ashen Reach should be an underground volcanic subregion of the volcano / Isles of Plenty, not a surface major region.
The Shrouded Isles was removed because it overlapped too much with existing concepts.
Remaining open island groups are intentionally preserved for future expansion of the forever world.
